newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin decides to sack defence minister - Tass.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin decides to sack defence minister - Tass.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin has decided to sack Defence Minister Igor Rodionov, Itar-Tass news agency said on Thursday, quoting sources in the Defence Council.
Yeltsin had earlier accused Rodionov of doing nothing to reform Russia's armed forces, which the president wants to transform from a conscript force into a professional army.

The Kremlin press service could not confirm the Tass report and said only that a meeting of the Defence Council, which is expected to discuss military reform and which is being chaired by Yeltsin, was continuing.
"I am not simply dissatisfied, I am indignant over the state of reforms in the army and the general state of the armed forces," Tass quoted Yeltsin as telling the Council.
"You have done a bad job in this direction. I am not satisfied and must draw conclusions," he was quoted as telling Rodionov, appointed a year ago, and other senior generals.
Rodionov is at odds with Yeltsin's top defence adviser, Yuri Baturin, over the reforms.
